verdict.rationale: OpenHands' own pricing page lists "Git integrations" as a feature, and the GitHub README describes automations that integrate with GitHub, which suggests first-party repository access. Nothing in the evidence describes a one-click install flow (such as a GitHub App install) or shows that setup is low-friction. missing for 10: documented one-click repository install/authorization flow, evidence that setup requires no complex configuration, details on how repository access is granted and scoped, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more.
